column3: MT 44:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “a maskil” is rendered “A Contemplation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you afflicted peoples and sent them out” is rendered “You afflicted the peoples, and cast them out.”
Close to the Hebrew; נְנַגֵּחַ (“we gore”) is rendered “we will push down.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for no wealth” is rendered “for next to nothing.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְצַלְמָוֶת (“deep darkness”) is rendered “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second עוּרָה (“awake”) is rendered “Arise!”
Close to the Hebrew; בִּטְנֵנוּ (“our belly”) is rendered “Our body.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercies’.”
